user.title: Connect your Bord Gáis account
user.description: Sign in on the Bord Gáis website, then privately paste the session JSON described in the README. Username/password-only login is not supported in this beta. Session tokens are stored by Home Assistant, never in the public repository.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew your Bord Gáis session
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again in your browser and paste fresh session JSON for the same accounts.

error.invalid_session: Paste valid session JSON containing accessToken, refreshToken and anonymousId.
error.invalid_auth: Session expired or rejected. Sign in again and copy a fresh session.
error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve account data. Try later.
error.rate_limited: The supplier is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.

abort.wrong_account: The session belongs to a different set of accounts. Add it as a separate integration.

init.title: Update frequency
init.description: 168 hours is weekly; 720 hours is every 30 days. Manual refresh remains available.
